faq.title: Questions dermatology practices ask before signing.

items.q: Is reputation management HIPAA-compliant for a dermatology practice?
items.a: Yes. Every invitation, response, and public post is written under HIPAA rules — we never confirm a patient relationship on a public reply, never reference a diagnosis, and never quote PHI. Review invitations are consent-based at the point of visit, and templates are reviewed by a compliance checklist before shipping.

items.q: How fast do star ratings actually improve?
items.a: For most single-location practices, we see the composite Google rating move 0.3–0.7 stars in the first 60–90 days. Multi-location groups typically stabilize above 4.7 across every site within one to two quarters. The variable is review velocity — practices that see 300+ patients a month move fastest.

items.q: What do you do about negative or unfair reviews?
items.a: Three parallel tracks. (1) A professional public response within 24 hours that de-escalates and moves the conversation offline. (2) An outreach playbook to resolve the underlying issue — many reviewers update or remove the review after resolution. (3) When a review clearly violates Google, Yelp, Healthgrades, or RealSelf policy, we file for removal with the platform.

items.q: Which review platforms do you cover?
items.a: Google Business Profile is the anchor. We also actively manage Healthgrades, RealSelf, Zocdoc, Yelp, Vitals, and Facebook Recommendations. NAP consistency and citations extend to 40+ directories so search engines trust every location.

items.q: Can you integrate with our EHR / PMS for review invitations?
items.a: Yes. We integrate with common dermatology PMS/EHR platforms (ModMed / EMA, Nextech, DrChrono, athenahealth, and others via CSV, API, or Zapier). Post-visit SMS + email invitations trigger 24 hours after a completed appointment, never during active clinical care.

items.q: Do you handle before/after review requests or aesthetic testimonials?
items.a: Yes, on a separate consent workflow. Aesthetic and cosmetic testimonials require a specific media release. Once signed, testimonials feed both your website and platform reviews — with paired before/after imagery where consented.

Flat monthly retainer scoped to number of locations and review volume — no per-review fees, no long contracts after the first 90 days. Retainer includes response management, invitation campaigns, GBP optimization, and monthly reporting.
